thread:
maria: Quick idea for the cost dashboard: instead of one big tenant rollup, what if we expose a 'prefetch heatmap' that shows which routes and model-skus get the most cache warmups and estimated dollar savings? Would help product teams debug wasted prefetching.
sam: Love the idea. How do you plan to attribute savings though? Prefetch and hotpath hits currently both show cache_hit=true in most sinks.
maria: Two approaches: (A) change the batcher to emit cache_event with `phase: prefetch|hotpath` (needs schema migration + rollout), or (B) do an offline lineage join: join traces of prefetch requests (we tag prefetch_id) to subsequent sessions that hit the same cache_key within TTL. B is heavier but non-invasive.
oliver: B seems safer short-term. We can use existing prefetch logs (they have prefetch_id and cache_key) and the read logs with cache_key and timestamp. A windowed join (prefetch_ts + ttl) -> credit prefetch savings to the prefetching route.
lisa: UX: users will want both absolute savings and pct of route cost. Suggest two columns: "estimated $ saved (sampled)" and "% of route cost from cache". Keep the default to tenant view and let users drill down.
maria: Good. Also propose a confidence signal: because we sample prefetch logs at ~15%, we should display a confidence band and show the sample rate used.
billing-bot: Reminder: any dashboard that exposes dollar amounts used for internal chargebacks must map to invoice primitives. Estimated savings are ok for ops, but billing numbers must be reconciled to gross token counts + credits.
sam: Implementation plan: 1) run 100% sampling for prefetch logs in staging for 1 hour, write to ephemeral bucket, 2) offline Spark job to compute join and aggregate per (tenant, route, model_sku), 3) wire the aggregates into the dashboard as a sampled layer with metadata (sample_rate, ttl, window).
oliver: Query sketch for step 2 (Spark SQL): ```sql
WITH prefetch AS (
  SELECT prefetch_id, cache_key, prefetch_ts, tenant_id, route
  FROM staging_prefetch_logs
  WHERE sample_rate = 1.0
), reads AS (
  SELECT cache_key, read_ts, tenant_id, route AS read_route
  FROM staging_cache_reads
)
SELECT p.tenant_id, p.route AS prefetch_route, r.read_route, p.cache_key,
  MIN(r.read_ts) as first_read_ts,
  CASE WHEN MIN(r.read_ts) <= p.prefetch_ts + interval '10m' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as credited
FROM prefetch p
JOIN reads r ON p.cache_key = r.cache_key AND r.read_ts > p.prefetch_ts
GROUP BY p.tenant_id, p.route, r.read_route, p.cache_key;
```
lisa: Nice. Let's show an example row in the UI: tenant, route, model_sku, estimated_savings, sample_rate, confidence_band, last_sample_ts. Keep wording: "estimated" prominent.
maria: Ops note: staging 100% sampling will still produce large files. I propose writing directly to the staging data lake (no upstream logging egress) and deleting after 7 days. Also gate the schema change if we go with A.
sam: If we ever do approach A, we should feature-flag emissions per deployment and add a telemetry toggle in the console for admins. Backfill compatibility: prefetch events will be missing historically so the offline join must be robust to that.
oliver: One more gotcha: sticky routing & canaries -> a prefetch from route_v1 might warm a cache that route_v2 reads. Attribution policy: credit the prefetching route + tenant, and annotate read_route separately. UI can show primary credit to prefetch_route and list affected read_routes.
lisa: For rollout, let's do: PHASE 1 (staging probe + offline pipeline), PHASE 2 (small-internal alpha in console), PHASE 3 (opt-in beta for select customers), PHASE 4 (GA). I'll make a UX ticket with mockups for the drilldown and heatmap.
maria: I'll open infra PR for the staging probe script and the Spark job. Sam, can you estimate storage and compute cost for a 1h 100% probe?
sam: Quick estimate: staging prefetch logs ~90 req/s -> ~320MB compressed over 1h, Spark join on that + reads (higher QPS) ~2-3 vCPU-hours, under $10 in staging credits. Will confirm.
billing-bot: Also, add copy to billing docs: "Prefetch savings are estimated from sampled telemetry and do not replace invoice calculations. Credits applied to invoices follow contractual terms and are finalized via billing export."
maria: Great. Action items: Maria -> infra PR for probe + sample retention policy. Sam -> staging cost confirmation + Spark job skeleton. Oliver -> proto for offline join, include TTL param. Lisa -> UX ticket with sample mockups and copy. We'll reconvene after the probe and post results here.
